thread.title: Jen Kiggans highlights military funding and border policy in recent tweets

author: D. I. Ramirez
title: Jen Kiggans highlights military funding and border policy in recent tweets
text:
Congresswoman Jen Kiggans, who represents Virginia’s 2nd district in the U.S. Congress, posted a series of updates on her official Twitter account this week, highlighting legislative efforts and constituent engagement.
On May 18, Kiggans stated her support for recent military appropriations: “I was proud to support last week’s MilConVa Appropriations bill that modernizes military housing, improves childcare resources for military families, and expands healthcare services for our veterans. Our servicemembers, military families, and veterans deserve nothing less than https://t.co/dPr8pCSIc5”.
The following day, she addressed border security measures: “Community safety and law and order begin with a secure southern border. For 12 straight months, there have been zero releases at the southern border, a clear sign that strong border enforcement and effective policies are making a difference. We must continue supporting the men https://t.co/BEqQRR5agt” (May 19).
Later on May 19, Kiggans promoted her regular communication with constituents: “Whether I’m at home in #VA02 or up in Washington, the best way to stay connected is through my weekly newsletter…! Sign up for the Weekly Debrief https://t.co/H1tdqWVkXA https://t.co/9URyj9FNiT”.
Kiggans has served as the representative for Virginia’s 2nd District since 2023 after succeeding Elaine Luria. She previously held office in the Virginia Senate from 2020 to 2022. Born in Tampa, Florida in 1971 and currently residing in Virginia Beach, Kiggans holds a Bachelor of Science in Nursing from Old Dominion University.
